source_freeze.classification: working-tree town Hero correction, exact source and test bytes

historical_assignment.role: Historical decisions are source candidates only. Fresh selected answers below do not borrow historical CURRENT certainty.

collapse_contract.decoded_and_file: Remove terminal .byte[n] and terminal scalar-array numeric indices. Retain repeated actor/archive/cell/group/packet owner identities. A uniform field has one whole-observed-field component. Different selected decision indices always retain separate components, even when answer classes match.
collapse_contract.typed: Remove consecutive terminal numeric JSON pointer indices for an atomic array member. Retain earlier indices naming repeated structure instances. Typed metadata remains a separate namespace.
collapse_contract.header_alias: Header.W144 and Header.W140 are one observed logical array owner, Header.Reserved (indices9..10). Their selected decisions remain named W144/W140 components.
collapse_contract.unwitnessed_schema: Remove the final catalog component selector from the owner key; retain the original selector in the selected component descriptor. Catalog selectors and their original decisions remain DEBT.

columns.selected_decision: Exactly one CURRENT,RULE or DEBT per owner. Any DEBT component selects DEBT. All CURRENT selects CURRENT. CURRENT/RULE without DEBT selects composite RULE with its rule claims and current operands.
columns.scope_contract: Relative component descriptors and owner keys are metadata, not captured values. Typed JSON metadata is separate. Compression packets are codec fields and never main decoded semantic counts.
